summary: Day: elevated corner shot of a sold-out 2023 game at sunset. Night: 2023 corner view under lights. Field sits mid-frame in both.

files.author: Bobak Ha'Eri
files.credit_line: Photo: Bobak Ha'Eri, CC BY 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons
files.note: Sunset, sold-out 2023 Nebraska opener, from high in the north-west corner of the upper bowl looking down the length of the field toward the scoreboard and downtown skyline; field rows ~900-1260 of 1800 (50-70%, centre-right), packed crowd wraps around and fills the bottom ~30%, sunset sky in the top ~35%

files.author: GoBlue9
files.credit_line: Photo: GoBlue9, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons
files.note: Night 2023 Michigan game from under the upper-deck overhang (dark band in the top ~8%), corner view; field rows ~810-1440 of 1800 (45-80%), packed far stands and scoreboard ~25-45%, crowd in the bottom ~20%
